lemma Commission.picks (Z : Commission V W I H) (hv : V.Inclusions S) (hp : V.Derivatives S) :
    ∃ c U J, Tab S V W I H c U J ∧ ∃ K0 : Boundary.Spins S, K0.Descends (mill W I c U) H.basis.kernel.spin := by
  obtain ⟨c,Hc⟩ := Z.scales hv hp (Z.shape hv hp)
  obtain ⟨U,hu,ht,hp'⟩ := Climb.descends W.T W.lit _ V Hc hp (Z.lens hv hp c Hc)
  obtain ⟨he,hh⟩ := Z.group c U hv hp ht hp'
  obtain ⟨J,h1,h2,h3⟩ := Z.retune c U hv hp Hc he hh
  have hj : Tab S V W I H c U J := ⟨Hc,hu,ht, hv,hp,H.aligned,he,hh, Climb.comparison H.weak,h1,h2,h3⟩
  refine ⟨c,U,J,hj,Spin.reach V W.T U (c⁻¹ • I.Y) hu ?_ hv H.basis.kernel.laws.toSymmetric W.vacuum W.rolls (Z.generate c U J hj)⟩
  exact Spin.transmits U _ W.lit _ ht

proof_context.conclusion: From Commission (proved by YM.Outer.commission) there are c, U, J with Crystal … c and the rotation laws for mill W I c U, whose generator field lie is c⁻¹ • I.Y.

structure Crystal (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (J : S.Stress) (p : Parts S) (Y : SpinRows S) (c : ℝ) : Prop where
  positive : c≠0
  pre : Shapes H V J p Y
  sizes d : leaves p d=c • leaves V.deriv d
  ready : commutes V ((c⁻¹:ℝ) • Y) ∧ Collinear V ((c⁻¹:ℝ) • Y)

proof_context.conclusion: c ≠ 0 and leaves p d = c • leaves V.deriv d: the translation charge maps are c times the derivatives.

infinitesimal (d : ℕ) (g : Ortho.Skew) (v : S.Field d) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => R.act d (Ortho.oneParameter g t) v) (R.lie d g v) (0 : ℝ)

proof_context.conclusion: lie d g v is the derivative at t=0 of t ↦ act d (oneParameter g t) v.
